name: image_segmentation.v1
description: Assigns one semantic class to each pixel of an RGB image.

image.description: RGB image in planar CHW format with values normalized to [0, 1]. Channels are ordered as Red, Green, then Blue.

mask.description: One class ID per input pixel, in row-major order. IDs are zero-based row indices into class_name; variants must remap sparse model IDs.

class_name.description: UTF-8 class names indexed by mask class ID, padded with zero bytes. Names are not required to be unique.
